deadline.quote: The deadline for applications for Autumn 2027, is Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 11:59 P.M., CST.

gre_general.quote: GRE test scores are optional, but applicants are strongly encouraged to submit the Mathematics Subject Test scores.

gre_subject.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit the Mathematics Subject Test; those who do not should briefly explain why in the application.
gre_subject.quote: GRE test scores are optional, but applicants are strongly encouraged to submit the Mathematics Subject Test scores.

fee_waiver.value: The department says application fee waivers cannot be granted to foreign applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Waivers cannot be granted to foreign applicants.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
toefl_min.quote: The Department of Mathematics requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall, and a minimum IELTS scores of 7.0 overall.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, if you do not meet the waiver criteria.
ielts_min.quote: The Department of Mathematics requires a minimum TOEFL score of 90 overall, and a minimum IELTS scores of 7.0 overall.

supervisor.value: Admissions decisions are made by the admissions committee; no prior supervisor agreement required.
supervisor.quote: The admissions committee generally finishes making decisions by March 31. As soon as a decision on your application has been made, you will be notified either by email or first class mail or airmail (for foreign applicants).

funding.value: Everyone admitted gets a full tuition scholarship and living stipend, guaranteed for up to five years subject to satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: All students who are offered admission will also be offered a full financial aid award which includes a full tuition scholarship and a living stipend. | Financial aid is guaranteed to admitted students for up to five years

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold or be completing a bachelor's degree or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to the University of Chicago's graduate programs are expected to be enrolled in or have completed a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from an accredited college or university.

notes: Computational and Applied Mathematics has its own separate PhD program, not recorded here.
